detail.longDescription: Firefox 131 added built-in tab groups — which is genuinely useful. But they don't save between sessions. Tab groups: in-session organization. Session managers: save/restore named workspaces across days and reboots. Both solve different problems. Wrote up the full breakdown: https:// dev.to/weatherclockdash/firefo x-tab-groups-vs-session-managers-what-the-browser-gives-you-vs-what-extensions-add-366p # Firefox # Productivity # BrowserExtension # TabManagement
